dct_description_sm: Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Shows topography, settlements, places of historical interest.
Features descriptive text and illustrations of structures, Israelites, and holy men.
"Dese wert gestelt voor het 3 cappitel Nehemia" -- bottom right corner.
